project.title: Core Payment Services Platform
project.summary: A full digital payments platform covering card activation, transactions, fee handling, and notifications.
project.description: The platform supported the full digital payment lifecycle and required dependable delivery across backend systems, interface work, infrastructure, and live production support.
project.role: Worked end-to-end across backend services, frontend integration, deployment, and production support.
project.imageAlt: Core Payment Services Platform project preview

sections.title: What the platform needed to support

blocks.content: The system had to support customer-facing payment activity and business-critical transaction handling at the same time. Features needed to move from planning to production smoothly while staying reliable in a high-impact domain.

items: Payment flows touched multiple stages of the user journey.
Backend, UI, infrastructure, and support work had to stay connected.
Reliability mattered because even small issues had direct operational impact.

blocks.content: The work was carried through with end-to-end ownership, balancing service development, interface integration, deployment, and support so the platform remained usable and stable under live conditions.

blocks.caption: The platform work connected transaction logic, service delivery, and operational follow-through so payments could remain dependable in production.

sections.title: What I owned across the stack

blocks.content: My role spanned backend services, interface integration, infrastructure touchpoints, and live production support, with features carried through from planning to release.

items: Built and maintained backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring Cloud.
Handled frontend integration needs through server-rendered UI work with Thymeleaf.
Worked with AWS services such as SQS and EC2 during deployment and delivery.
Took features through planning, implementation, release, and production support.
Supported dependable payment workflows across multiple stages of the user journey.
Improved delivery continuity by handling both implementation and operational follow-through.
Enabled business-critical features to ship with clearer end-to-end ownership.
Strengthened the platform's day-to-day reliability for production payment operations.
